subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should that detection run only in an explicit check/Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so the permanent product boundary needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor, with clear remediation and configured-root exclusions.

options.title: Startup Warning Too
options.body: Also surface warnings during startup, accepting extra operator-visible noise and filesystem scanning at runtime.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor, with clear remediation and configured-root exclusions.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses skills CLI, bundled skill-creator, and workspace audit behavior where Peter has the strongest feature-history trail.
